_comment: Emergency contacts. The most safety-critical data on this site — a wrong number here costs a dog. Nothing in this file may be inferred, rounded, or carried over from a listing site. Every number needs a first-party confirmation call before verifiedDate is set, and the hours need re-checking seasonally because urgent-care hours at coastal practices move with the season.

headline.fact: There is no 24-hour emergency vet in Sussex County.
headline.detail: That is the single most important thing on this page and almost nobody tells visitors. If your dog is in trouble at 11pm at Rehoboth, the nearest round-the-clock option is an hour or more away. Know which one you're driving to BEFORE you need it — pick one now and put it in your phone.

vets.name: Delmarva Animal Emergency Center
vets.hoursNote: NOT 24/7 on weekdays — it opens at 6pm and closes at 8am. A Tuesday afternoon emergency is not covered here.

vets.name: Pet's ER
vets.hoursNote: Closest option to Fenwick and Bethany. Confirm hours and whether they take out-of-state clients.

vets.name: BluePearl Pet Hospital, Christiana
vets.hoursNote: The only genuine round-the-clock option in Delaware, but it is at the top of the state — a long drive from the beaches.

vets.name: Rehoboth Beach Animal Hospital
vets.hours: Urgent care, reported five days a week
vets.hoursNote: Nearest urgent care to the beach towns, but it is urgent care and not a 24-hour ER. Confirm the days, the hours, and whether they see non-clients.

statewide.label: Emergency: people
statewide.note: Always. Beach emergencies, injuries, anything time-critical.

statewide.label: Delaware SPCA
statewide.note: Stray and loose-dog intake. Number not yet confirmed.

statewide.label: Animal Poison Control (ASPCA)
statewide.note: 24 hours. A consultation fee usually applies. Useful for a swallowed bait, a bloom exposure, or anything eaten off the sand.

outstanding: Call every number in this file and confirm it rings the right place. This is the one dataset where a stale number does real harm.
